title: E-commerce Platform
description: A full-featured e-commerce platform built with Next.js, TypeScript, and Stripe integration. Features include product management, shopping cart, checkout flow, and admin dashboard.

title: Analytics Dashboard
description: Real-time analytics dashboard for business intelligence. Features interactive charts, data visualization, and custom reporting tools built with D3.js and React.

title: Task Management System
description: A collaborative task management application with real-time updates, drag-and-drop functionality, and team collaboration features. Built with React, Redux, and Firebase.

title: API Gateway Service
description: A scalable API gateway service that handles authentication, rate limiting, and request routing for microservices architecture. Built with Node.js, Express, and Redis.

title: Mobile App Backend
description: Backend services for a mobile application including user authentication, data storage, and real-time notifications. Built with NestJS, PostgreSQL, and AWS services.

title: CI/CD Pipeline System
description: Automated CI/CD pipeline system for continuous integration and deployment. Features automated testing, code quality checks, and deployment to multiple environments.
